props.name: controller
props.description: The controller managing this component's state and behaviour. Bind to it to access the component's imperative API.

props.name: onfirstcreate
props.description: A callback that fires when the component's controller is first created.

props.name: header
props.description: The header content of the target, above the grid.

props.name: children
props.description: The child content of the target, which should contain inner FlexiWidget definitions.

props.name: footer
props.description: The footer content of the target, below the grid.

props.name: containerClass
props.description: The class names to apply to the target's container element.

props.name: class
props.description: The class names to apply to the target's grid element.

props.name: config
props.description: The configuration object for the target.

props.name: key
props.description: The unique identifier for the target. Used to identify the target when layouts are imported or exported.

properties.name: config
properties.description: The reactive configuration of the target.

properties.name: providerWidgetDefaults
properties.description: The reactive default widget configuration passed through from the provider, if it exists.

properties.name: prepared
properties.description: Whether the target is prepared and ready to render widgets.

properties.name: dropRejected
properties.description: Whether a widget is currently being grabbed or resized over this target at a position where it cannot be placed. Use it to signal that the drop will be rejected.

properties.name: columns
properties.description: The number of columns currently being used in the target grid. This value is readonly.

properties.name: rows
properties.description: The number of rows currently being used in the target grid. This value is readonly.

properties.name: widgets
properties.description: The widgets currently in this target.

methods.name: createWidget
methods.description: Creates a new widget under this target.

FlexiTargetPartialConfiguration.name: rowSizing
FlexiTargetPartialConfiguration.type: string | (({ target, grid }: { target: FlexiTargetController; grid: FlexiGrid }) => string)
FlexiTargetPartialConfiguration.description: Allows the specifying of the value inside the `repeat()` function of the `grid-template-rows` CSS property for the target.

FlexiTargetPartialConfiguration.name: columnSizing
FlexiTargetPartialConfiguration.type: string | (({ target, grid }: { target: FlexiTargetController; grid: FlexiGrid }) => string)
FlexiTargetPartialConfiguration.description: Allows the specifying of the value inside the `repeat()` function of the `grid-template-columns` CSS property for the target.

FlexiTargetPartialConfiguration.name: layout
FlexiTargetPartialConfiguration.description: The layout algorithm and parameters to use for the target grid.

FlexiTargetPartialConfiguration.name: widgetDefaults
FlexiTargetPartialConfiguration.description: The default configuration for widgets within this target.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: draggable
FlexiWidgetDefaults.deprecated: Prefer the use of `draggability` instead for finer control. When `true`, `draggability = 'full'`, when `false`, `draggability = 'none'`.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: width
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The width of the widget in units.
FlexiWidgetDefaults.deprecated: This property does not work and will be removed in the next version.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: height
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The height of the widget in units.
FlexiWidgetDefaults.deprecated: This property does not work and will be removed in the next version.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: snippet
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The snippet that is rendered by this widget.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: component
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The component that is rendered by this widget.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: componentProps
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The props applied to the component rendered, if it has one.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: className
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The class names to apply to this widget.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: transition
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The transition configuration for this widget.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: grabTrigger
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The configuration for how pointer events should trigger a grab event on the widget. E.g. a long press.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: resizeTrigger
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The configuration for how pointer events should trigger a resize event on the widget. E.g. a long press.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: minWidth
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The minimum width of the widget in units. Defaults to 1, cannot be less than 1.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: minHeight
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The minimum height of the widget in units. Defaults to 1, cannot be less than 1.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: maxWidth
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The maximum width of the widget in units. Defaults to Infinity, cannot be less than 1.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: maxHeight
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The maximum height of the widget in units. Defaults to Infinity, cannot be less than 1.
